check.title: Selected Artifact Registry file has no detected secrets
check.remediation: Remove exposed credentials from the selected file and rotate confirmed exposed credentials.
evidence_sentences: A likely secret was detected in an explicitly selected Artifact Registry file.
The value is hidden; detection did not validate the credential.

ownership: Worker changed only new artifact-file modules, gzip, tests, reports and proposal artifacts. Root owns shared admission/options/collector/planner/registry/group/catalog hooks.

native_fields.name: Exact canonical File.name; example files/a%2Fb%2Fc.txt. Escaped filename retained once in native reserved expansion, not quoted again into %252F.
native_fields.sizeBytes: Canonical decimal int64 string, bounded and checked against full actual bytes and required HTTP Content-Length.
native_fields.hashes: Unique canonical base64 SHA256 must decode to32bytes and match selected lowercase hex SHA256; actual full media bytes must match it before any complete result. MD5 or DIRSUM_SHA256 cannot substitute; ancillary hashes are shape-checked, not additional content attestations.

scope_and_activation.named: Exact internally selected artifact_selected_file kind derived by named planner, never category/framework activation.
scope_and_activation.selection_validation: Entire selection validated before credentials/session/reads: exact requested scopes, canonical escaped name bound to same scope, supported format and lowercase64hex digest, no duplicate native name or extra key.
scope_and_activation.double_encoding: Conservative rejection of decoded percent-HH sequences avoids ambiguous %252F selection. Literal filenames containing such sequences are intentionally unsupported.
scope_and_activation.zero_default: No selected File calls, sessions, credentials or tools unless boolean opt-in, exact selected kind and valid selectors. Ordinary requested metadata dependencies retain baseline reads.
scope_and_activation.enumeration: No files.list, packages/versions discovery, mutable tag expansion, broad package downloads or pagination added.

authority.project: Completed ordinary native CRM v3 project name projects/{number}+projectId binds requested ID/number; contradictory optional legacy projectNumber rejected.
authority.repository: Completed artifact_repository collection with exactly one exact native parent, explicit STANDARD_REPOSITORY mode and known non-DOCKER format. Exact binding fields use shared facts.get; unrelated IAM hydration coverage does not invalidate them.
authority.unsupported: Missing, partial, denied or foreign dependency, unknown/omitted mode, DOCKER, REMOTE, VIRTUAL and AOSS repositories remain UNKNOWN without File reads.
authority.grants: Both content GET methods require artifactregistry.files.get; success proves the specific read was allowed, not an effective IAM policy verdict. Existing project/repository inventory/list/IAM grants remain baseline dependencies. No new grant, impersonation, policy mutation or managed-secret permission.

transport.session: Dedicated requests.Session, trust_env=False, cleared ambient headers/proxies/cookies, explicit identity auth callable prevents netrc/challenge fallback; cookies cleared before/after reads.
transport.headers: Only validated native Bearer authorization, Accept, identity Accept-Encoding and optional quota-project. No auth helpers, external URL or package/client execution.
transport.requests: Fixed HTTPS artifactregistry.googleapis.com metadata/media GET only, stream=True, allow_redirects=False, no retry path. Exact prepared response URL and empty redirect history required.
integrity: Required bounded Content-Length equals full byte count
Metadata application/json with strict UTF8, duplicate-key/nonfinite JSON rejection
Canonical native name,size,SHA256 plus selected SHA256 and actual full media hash checked
Remaining transport/content deadline tightened per socket read where available
Response close and dedicated session close on all read outcomes
transport.privacy: No File URL/name, selected content digest, native/error body, raw content, filename/member names or snippets in evidence/cache. Receipts expose fixed operation/scope/status/byte count and opaque target identity only.
transport.wire_limits: Metadata at most16KiB/read; media at most1MiB/file plus8MiB scan-wide. No chunked/missing-length success or ranged/redirected transport proof claimed.

formats.utf8: Strict UTF8 with binary/control/archive magic rejection. The chosen format is not a service-provided MIME assertion; the native File has no contentType field.
formats.archives: Reuse unchanged GCP selected-archive _parse and its private FunctionType per-call mapping over audited scan_zip/scan_tar; only memory-only parser code and deadline facade used. AWS globals/network/context helpers never changed or invoked.
formats.unsupported: Traversal, links, encryption, truncation, nested archives/binary members, unsupported compression/format, decompression bombs and directory-only/no-regular-text archives remain UNKNOWN. No extraction to disk, installation or execution.

bounds.notes: UTF8 files also charge expanded/member totals; failed archive attempts conservatively consume full reserved expansion allowance. Existing transport call/deadline/cancel budgets also apply. No enumeration/pages.

detectors.verification: not_attempted; existing shared pinned offline adapters, TruffleHog no-verification/no-update/no-verification-cache/force-skip-archives
detectors.dedup: Shared process-keyed exact-value HMAC and merge_leaks combine both tools and existing finding merge across owners/services. Two selected files with repeated archive members produce one hidden value. Other service combinations inherit shared implementation but were not individually retested.
detectors.evidence: Hidden fingerprints/detector descriptors plus fixed artifact.content or archive.member-N locations only; no raw member names/values/tool output.
detectors.failures: Any missing/failed engine or incomplete/unsupported content produces UNKNOWN; a complete negative only covers the exact full digest-verified selected content.

consumer.native_binding: Opaque target identity, same GCP scope, unique collected envelope membership, exactly metadata+download request IDs in collection/item provenance/marker coverage required.
consumer.schema: Exact marker schema/identity/format/completeness/digest_verified, byte/member bounds and both pinned complete engine identities for every regular text file.
consumer.group: Desired existing secrets group; root owns exact finding-type metadata and registry invocation.
consumer.copy: Desired-state high title and two brief positive evidence sentences in DECLARATION; no whole-package/service absence language.

tests.native_pipeline: Actual installed GCPCollector.collect project CRM v3/Compute, repository list/IAM hydration and dependent selected File job -> dedicated metadata/media stream -> pure callback. Only HTTP and fake native credentials mocked; no scheduling fallback/injection.
tests.direct_proof: Other cases use actual collector.envelope plus native mocked metadata/media and complete native-shaped project/repository dependency fixtures, separately from full collector proof.
tests.real_tools: Eight supported-format positive/negative cases plus one cross-file/archive duplicate value and native collector ZIP positive use real installed engines. Clean contract tests stub engine outputs only where scanner mechanics are irrelevant.
tests.primary_escape_proof: Google canonical a%2Fb%2Fc.txt example produces exact once-escaped prepared metadata/download URLs; noncanonical and double-encoded target spellings rejected.
branches: Default/missing-kind/wrong-kind/string boolean causes zero File calls/sessions/credential acquisition/tools; actual constructor rejects string boolean
Native size/digest/identity missing/mismatch, hash encoding/duplicate JSON keys
Remote/virtual/Docker/legacy project contradiction and exact-field authority
Shared total bytes/calls/deadline/members, cancellation and one-engine failure
Opaque names, payload/error/privacy, response/session close and unchanged AWS scanner globals
Normal idempotent install plus native PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN and missing/malformed fixtures
tests.isolation: Helper and tests fail closed on Python socket.connect/connect_ex/create_connection and getaddrinfo; explicit escape assertion. Shared detector offline flags apply; no OS subprocess egress sandbox attested.
tests.attribution: Reuses audited existing GCP archive facade, AWS parser implementation only through private callback mappings, strict GCS UTF8 detector helper, native collector envelope, shared secret HMAC/merge and field coverage accessor. No shared/full suites run.

runtime_cases.unknown_source: Actual full native metadata/media digest-bound bytes are binary for an explicitly selected utf8 format; producer rejects them, no private evidence forged.

integration.collector: Dependent collection_pages after complete native project+artifact_repository; default-excluded artifact_selected_file
integration.observed: Root installed supported/default-excluded kind, dependent scheduling, named engine/intake validation before native proof. Normal local installer tested; root owns registry import, group/catalog/hosted routing and broader acceptance.

unresolved_contracts: Native-shaped fixtures are offline synthetic data, not authenticated Google project responses; authorization and real cloud timing are not certified.
Only the exact selected File bytes/text members at the selected digest are covered; no all-repository/package/version/service absence, remote/virtual/Docker or package installation coverage.
No missing SHA256 fallback to MD5/DIRSUM; absent native hash or unsupported canonical name/mode/representation remains UNKNOWN.
Domain-scoped projects, unproven project alias rewrites, literal percent-HH filenames and unsupported formats remain outside strict selector contract.
Size and selected/native SHA256 bind actual bytes despite mutable names; there is no native conditional generation pin on this method and no claim of service-side immutable naming.
Missing Content-Length/chunked responses, redirects, nonidentity encoding or ranges remain UNKNOWN rather than relaxed integrity.
Shared root code hashes are observed snapshots, not proof of every CLI/hosted/planner/registry/catalog branch.
